meta.title: Media Gallery
meta.description: A selectable media grid for images, video, audio, and documents. Multi-select, type filtering, keyboard-navigable lightbox, and drag-to-reorder via the Sortable system.

blocks.content: A media grid sounds simple — it isn't. Multi-select needs Shift, Cmd, and Ctrl to all behave correctly. The lightbox needs keyboard navigation, needs to track which subset of items are previewable, and needs to close cleanly. Filtering by type means the grid, the selection state, and the lightbox index all need to stay in sync. Reorder means drag-and-drop wired to the same state.

GalleryRoot owns all of it through context. The default layout — toolbar, grid, lightbox — is rendered automatically. Pass children to replace it with your own composition using the same useGallery hook.

blocks.title: Sortable dependency
blocks.content: Gallery uses the Bevel Sortable system internally when config.sortable is true. The shadcn install command pulls both. If you already have Sortable installed, only the gallery files are added.
Click to select, Cmd/Ctrl+click to multi-select, double-click to open the lightbox. Filter by type with the tabs above. Drag to reorder.
Gallery has no npm dependencies beyond what Sortable already requires.

steps.title: Add the files
steps.description: Installs gallery + its sortable dependency into components/bevelui/.

steps.title: Import and use
steps.code:
import { GalleryRoot } from "@/components/bevelui/gallery";
import type { GalleryItem } from "@/components/bevelui/gallery";

blocks.content: Pass an items array to GalleryRoot. The default layout — filter toolbar, responsive grid, and lightbox — renders automatically.
Use the onSelect callback to receive selected IDs whenever the selection changes. In multi mode, Cmd/Ctrl+click adds to the selection. Shift+click selects a range.

blocks.code:
<GalleryRoot
  items={items}
  onSelect={(selectedIds) => {
    // selectedIds: string[]
    setSelectedIds(selectedIds);
  }}
  config={{ selectionMode: "multi" }}
/>

blocks.content: Set config.sortable to true and pass onReorder to persist the new order. The grid wraps itself in a SortableRoot internally — no extra setup needed.
Pass children to GalleryRoot to replace the default layout entirely. useGallery gives you access to the full context — items, selection, filter, lightbox controls.
